output.text: Good evening, everyone! Today, we gather to welcome a new chapter on the water—our beloved vessel, now named Small Tomorrow. May this boat carry us to distant shores, yet always return to a steady harbor. May it hold room for wonder, just as every great journey begins with a small step. Here’s to Small Tomorrow—may it sail with courage, curiosity, and joy. Cheers!
